artboards.title: Section — short points, click for depth

annotations.text:
The two homes side by side.
The lens changes the TYPEFACE, not just the color — mono for engineers, serif for clients.
That is a register change a recruiter or a client actually feels.
Toggle on the left artboard is live; click it.

Per-lens primary action.
Engineer gets résumé. Client gets book a call.
Before, both lenses showed the same four icons — the toggle changed the paint and nothing else.
résumé also sits in the bar's right corner, replacing the fake ln/col readout.

Short points only. One pulsing dot marks the current role.
Records with a write-up get read more. Records without get a fallback line and no dead link — the loader decides, not you.
Schema allows exactly one current:true per collection. Two dots and the signal is worthless.

Still every placeholder in brackets.
Taglines shown are my drafts, not yours — I wrote them to show the shape a real one has.
Send years, role, company, domain and I replace all of it.
